welcome.subject: Welcome to Mobius Digital, Pat
welcome.body:
Hi Pat,

Welcome aboard. We are excited to get started on Northlake Golf.

Everything starts from one link:
{{sign-in link}}

It opens Locus, the app we run Northlake Golf from. Make your login (Google, or a code we email you), then four short steps: sign and pay, connect your accounts, ten questions only you can answer, and a link to your photos and videos. It saves as you go. If someone else on your team should do a step, press "Someone else does this" and we email them.

Our agreement comes in a separate email from me, and the first invoice from Stripe. Both are on your checklist too.
You will also get an invite to our shared Slack channel.

Talk soon,

Sample text only. The real agreement comes from the server.
